content:
rachel: NimbusEdge partner just dropped their compliance package. They included firmware images, manifest.json (with serials), full pen-report, and a SOC2 excerpt. Legal wants a small, repeatable playbook for marketplace publication.
ben-platform: can we inline a minimal publish vs restricted policy? i.e., what goes public, what needs presign, archive rules.
omar-partner: Partner notes: they can provide a signed attestation, but are nervous about sharing full cert chains publicly. prefer redaction + presign for reviewers.
selena-legal: For public listing we accept: redacted manifest, one-line attestation, SOC2 controls summary. Full pen-report & firmware only via presign to NDA'd reviewers. We need a standard evidence-access addendum.
mike-sec: Security constraints: - Redact unique identifiers (serial, hw_id, mac) - Replace with deterministic placeholders (REDACTED-<8hex>) so reviewers can correlate across artifacts - Keep original artefacts in KMS-encrypted bucket, retention 12 months - Presign TTL default 7 days, require access ticket + approver.
ben-platform: small jq redaction example to share with SI: ```bash
jq '.serial = "REDACTED" | .hw_id = "REDACTED" | del(.signer_cert)' manifest.json > manifest.public.json
```
ben-platform: deterministic placeholder suggestion: use sha256 and take first 8 chars. simple python snippet available if needed.
ci-bot: ci-bot: created ticket MP-1087 to automate redaction + presign workflow and added runbook stub: https://confluence.redwood.internal/marketplace/NimbusEdge-playbook :gear:
omar-partner: we'll provide signed attestation PDF and a contact for the pen-test witness window. can we include a short checklist for them?
selena-legal: Checklist to give partner: 1) Signed attestation PDF 2) Manifest with clear field labels 3) SOC2 excerpt (controls only) 4) Pen-report uploaded to secure bucket for reviewers 5) Contact name/email for reviewer coordination
mike-sec: operational checklist for us: 1) Run deterministic redaction on manifest 2) compute SHA256 of redacted artifact 3) upload public bundle to marketplace assets 4) store raw evidence in secure bucket with CMK and MFA delete 5) create presign link after access ticket approval 6) log all actions in audit S3 prefix
rachel: who volunteers to run the first redaction and presign? ben?
ben-platform: I can run it. Plan: run redaction, create public zip, compute hashes, upload to s3://marketplace-artifacts/nimbusedge/2025-04/, create presign for reviewers, add audit entry with requester & purpose.
ci-bot: ci-bot: presign policy note: use short-lived role for reviewer if possible; otherwise presign link with --expires-in 604800. CloudTrail events will be stored for audit.
omar-partner: we'll prepare the attestation and coordinate NDA for reviewers. can you confirm we will not publish firmware binary publicly?
selena-legal: Confirmed: firmware binaries remain restricted; public listing will reference that full artifacts are available to authorized parties. I'll draft the legal copy line and post it here.
mike-sec: one more: require SHA256 of raw firmware and public bundle in the audit note so we can verify integrity if reviewer requests it.
rachel: timeline recap: Ben to run redaction + public bundle today and post presign + SHA256 in this thread by EOD. Selena to post legal listing copy. Omar to get attestation and reviewer contacts. Mike to ensure archive and audit controls applied.
ben-platform: on it. will post proof artifacts: manifest.public.json, presign link, and hashes here.
selena-legal: I'll also attach a 1-paragraph evidence access addendum for NimbusEdge.
ci-bot: ci-bot: linked runbook: https://confluence.redwood.internal/marketplace/NimbusEdge-playbook - please use this thread for any follow ups. :white_check_mark:
rachel: thanks team  marking this thread canonical for NimbusEdge marketplace evidence flow. if anything slips ping @rachel.
